title: PrerenderOptions
summary: Explicit route selection and build inputs for opt-in prerendering.

sections.title: Route selection
sections.body: paths is required: pass concrete pathnames or an async callback selecting from discovered static paths. An empty list renders nothing. Configure directory only for callback discovery. The default client entry is src/entry.client.tsx and client output is dist/client. See prerenderPlugin for the two-build setup, output safety and worker lifetime.
